releaseNotes: MEC POS v3.39.45: Enhanced Management Access & Daily Cash Balancing — Branch Managers, Sales Managers, and Supervisors can now view daily/monthly sales figures, Executive Dashboard, revenue charts, and staff directory. Daily Cash Balancing defaults to All Cashiers (Total Branch Sales).
